sources.label: Morphe patches for the FanFiction.Net Android app: fewer server requests, no tel
sources.author: Tao
patch_list: Keeps story covers and avatars on the device for 7 days instead of downloading them again every time they are shown. Images use the same one-at-a-time server queue as everything else, so this also makes stories and lists load sooner.
Stops Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics and Sessions from collecting and uploading data.
Logs network requests, request failures, HTTP/2 frames and the app's internal debug messages to logcat under the tag FFNTao. For troubleshooting only.
Opens favorite stories filtered to one starting letter instead of all titles. Use this when the full favorites list fails to load. Other letters stay available in the A-Z bar.

Sends identical API requests that are in flight at the same time only once, and shares the response. The server answers one request at a time, so every duplicate removed makes the rest of the app respond sooner.
Changes the default API request timeout from 30 seconds. The server answers one request at a time, so a longer timeout also makes screens wait longer behind a slow request.
Removes the advertising ID, ad attribution and install referrer permissions.
Renames the app and recolors its launcher icon so a patched install can be told apart from the official app installed alongside it.
Skips pulling synced bookmarks, folders, history and offline stories from the server when the same sync already ran recently. Saves about six server requests on most app starts.
